description: This file defines the ApiClient class for handling HTTP API requests, including methods for GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE. It manages authentication tokens via shared preferences, includes retry logic, and handles response parsing and errors.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: Service class for managing API requests with authentication, retries, and error handling.

methods.name: ApiClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the API client with base URL, shared preferences, and optional retry configuration.

methods.name: authToken
methods.description: Getter retrieving the stored authentication token from shared preferences.

methods.name: setAuthToken
methods.description: Stores an authentication token into shared preferences.

methods.name: clearAuthToken
methods.description: Removes the stored authentication token from shared preferences.

methods.name: _headers
methods.description: Private getter that constructs headers for HTTP requests, including authorization if token is available.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the specified endpoint with error handling and retries.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with provided data, including error handling and retries.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Performs an HTTP PUT request with provided data, including error handling and retries.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Performs an HTTP DELETE request to the specified endpoint with error handling.

methods.name: _handleResponse
methods.description: Parses the HTTP response, decodes JSON, and throws exceptions based on status code.
